  <title>Ebola disease: Multi-country outbreak 2026</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/ebola-disease-multi-country-outbreak-2026</link>
  <description><p>Since May 2026, an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has been ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).</p>
</description>

<item>
  <title>Epidemiological update – 11 August 2026: Imported case of Andes hantavirus in the EU/EEA</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-11-august-2026-imported-case-andes-hantavirus-eueea</link>
  <description><p>On 6 August 2026, French public health authorities reported an imported case of Andes hantavirus infection in a traveller from Argentina.&nbsp;</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Thu, 20 Aug 2026 13:39:42 +0200</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>ECDC</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-11-august-2026-imported-case-andes-hantavirus-eueea</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>Andes hantavirus outbreak in cruise ship</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/infectious-disease-topics/hantavirus-infection/surveillance-and-updates/andes-hantavirus-outbreak</link>
  <description><p>ECDC was notified on 2 May 2026 of a cluster of severe respiratory illness on MV Hondius, a Dutch-flagged cruise ship with passengers and crew from 23 countries, including nine EU/EEA countries. The virus has been identified as Andes hantavirus.</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 26 May 2026 17:56:17 +0200</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>ECDC</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/infectious-disease-topics/hantavirus-infection/surveillance-and-updates/andes-hantavirus-outbreak</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>Epidemiological update: Spread of multidrug-resistant and extensively-drug resistant Shigella in Europe</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-spread-multidrug-resistant-and-extensively-drug-resistant</link>
  <description><p>Since 2023, 14 countries have reported more than 2 300 infections caused by multidrug-resistant (MDR) or extensively drug-resistant (XDR) Shigella sonnei and Shigella flexneri to ECDC. Seven genetically distinct MDR/XDR clusters, some with prolonged circulation and others more recent, have been reported.</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 20 May 2026 13:16:59 +0200</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>ECDC</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-spread-multidrug-resistant-and-extensively-drug-resistant</guid>
    </item>

<item>
  <title>Epidemiological update: Shigellosis and other gastrointestinal infections in travellers returning from Cabo Verde</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-shigellosis-and-other-gastrointestinal-infections-travellers</link>
  <description><p>As of March 2026, over 1 000 confirmed and possible cases of shigellosis and other gastrointestinal infections, including salmonellosis, have been detected in travellers returning from Cabo Verde to several countries in the European Union/European Economic Area (EU/EEA), the United Kingdom (UK), and the United States (US), with new cases still being reported.</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:32:55 +0100</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>ECDC</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/epidemiological-update-shigellosis-and-other-gastrointestinal-infections-travellers</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>Early estimates of seasonal influenza vaccine effectiveness against influenza requiring medical attention at primary care level in Europe, week 41 - 49, 2025</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/early-estimates-seasonal-influenza-vaccine-effectiveness-against-influenza-requiring</link>
  <description><p>The 2025/26 influenza season has begun earlier than the previous two seasons, driven by the recently-emerged influenza virus A(H3N2) subclade K.</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 19 Dec 2025 14:32:38 +0100</pubDate>

    </item>
<item>
  <title>Two cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS) in travellers returning to France from the Arabian Peninsula</title>
  <link>https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-events/cases-middle-east-respiratory-syndrome-coronavirus-mers-cov-travellers</link>
  <description><p>On 3 December 2025, the French Ministry of Health reported two imported human Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS) cases with travel history to the Arabian Peninsula.</p>
</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 05 Dec 2025 16:43:12 +0100</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>ECDC</dc:creator>
